content: वासनम् [वास्-ल्युट्] .²1 Perfuming, scenting. .²2 Infusing. .²3 Dwelling, abiding .²4 An abode, a dwelling. .²5 Any receptacle, a basket, box, vessel <ab>&c.</ab>; वासनस्थमनाख्याय हस्तेऽन्यस्य यदर्प्यते <ls>Y. 2. 65</ls> (वासनं निक्षेपाधारभूतं संपुटादिकं समुद्रं ग्रन्थ्यादियुतम्). .²6 Knowledge. .²7 Clothes, dress. .²8 A cover, an envelope. .²9 A kind of posture practised by ascetics in abstract meditation.
